title: Effect Events read the latest values

slides.say: You log every page visit with the URL and the number of items in the cart.
Now adding an item to the cart logs another visit. But changing the cart does not mean the user visited again.
Split it. The Effect stays reactive to url. The Effect Event reads the latest number of items without reacting to it.

slides.text: Pass url as an argument: each new url is a separate visit.
slides.say: Pass url as an argument. It says a different URL is a separate event, and the linter warns if you drop url from the dependencies.
